_what: Read by the Adspenta operator console's Marketing page (read-only). Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. Update it from the social chat whenever a token is renewed, credits are used or reset, or a reminder is done.

YouTube Shorts run out on 30 Oct: book the next batch (PostMCP credits reset 1 Nov, or move to YouTube's own API)
Metricool credits reset: schedule the next TikTok batch
LinkedIn posts run out on 11 Nov: write the next three weeks
Stories run out on 15 Nov: make the next month
Instagram token expires 10 Dec: renew it and update the GitHub secret
LinkedIn token expires 12 Dec: renew it and update the GitHub secret
